_comment: Edit this file to add or change a source. A source is only crawled when its access_rule is open_api or crawl_allowed, so changing a rule is a security decision and must carry its evidence in `basis`.

sources.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
sources.basis: A free public API offered for reuse, within its rate limits. GDELT is cited on every row it produces; the query is an adapter setting, not a separate source.

sources.name: EastMojo
sources.basis: Publishes a public RSS feed, and robots.txt blocks only /wp-json/. Covers news across all eight North East states.

sources.name: YouTube Data API
sources.basis: An official API used under Google's terms and quota, with a key. Gives channel and video metadata rather than page scraping.

sources.name: The Morung Express
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths and no RSS feed was found, so the pages themselves are the route. Nagaland coverage.

sources.name: The Sentinel (Assam)
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths and no RSS feed was found. Assam coverage; terms of use were not read.

sources.name: Northeast Now
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths and a feed is likely at /feed. Covers news across the North East region.

sources.name: The Shillong Times
sources.basis: robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/, so the article pages and the likely /feed route are permitted. Meghalaya coverage.

sources.name: Nagaland Post
sources.basis: robots.txt explicitly allows the feed paths, which is the cleanest route into it. Nagaland coverage.

sources.name: Eastern Mirror
sources.basis: robots.txt allows everything except /em-admin, and no RSS feed was found. Nagaland coverage.

sources.name: Imphal Free Press
sources.basis: robots.txt allows articles and blocks search and /wp-json/. A Cloudflare bot check may still stop a crawler in practice. Manipur coverage.

sources.name: The Arunachal Times
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths and a feed is likely at /index.php/feed/. Arunachal Pradesh coverage.

sources.name: The CSR Journal
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths. Carries CSR sector news; terms of use were not read, so check them before production use.

sources.name: India Development Review
sources.basis: robots.txt allows articles but disallows the feed paths, so the RSS route must not be polled. Sector analysis rather than entity records.

sources.name: MHA FCRA notifications
sources.basis: robots.txt answered 503 from outside India, so automated access is unestablished. A person may read the notices and enter what matters.

sources.name: The Assam Tribune
sources.basis: robots.txt returned no readable rules when checked, so whether automated access is permitted is unknown. Check again before crawling.

sources.name: Tripura Times
sources.basis: robots.txt answered 503 when checked, so its rules could not be read and automated access is unestablished. Tripura coverage.

sources.name: Alliance Magazine
sources.basis: robots.txt returned no readable rules, so whether it permits automated reading is unknown. Philanthropy sector news.

sources.name: Devex
sources.basis: The site answered 403 including for robots.txt, and its content sits behind a paid subscription. A licence is needed before any use.

sources.name: X (Twitter) API
sources.basis: Access is a paid, pay-per-use API. Ruled out for continuous monitoring on cost, so items are checked by hand when they matter.

sources.name: LinkedIn
sources.basis: LinkedIn's robots.txt permits crawling only under its written whitelist approval, and posts about people are personal data under the DPDP Act.

sources.name: Instagram and Facebook (Meta Graph API)
sources.basis: Meta's terms bar scraping, and the Graph API needs app review before it returns public page posts. Manual checking only until that is approved.

sources.name: Node/SeSTA news and newsletters
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths. Carries cohort news and partner events; Node is a project partner, so confirm reuse as a courtesy.
